verdict.rationale: Modal publishes an SDK API reference (Sandbox, Probe and SandboxSnapshot pages) and code examples users can run themselves, such as the LLM coding-agent example and the JS/Go exec snippets. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples run in the browser, and no OpenAPI or Swagger spec was found for an explorable reference. Missing for 10: an interactive or try-it API explorer, in-browser runnable examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of the docs experience.
